title: Electrodeposition, microstructure and characterization of high-strength, low-roughness copper foils with polyethylene glycol additives
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38268-38278
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06688J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jian Huang, Ning Song, Mingwei Chen, Yunzhi Tang, Xiaowei Fan
High-quality copper foils with high tensile strength (433.2 MPa) and low surface roughness (1.7 μm) were electrodeposited with PEG, exhibiting high (220) crystal plane orientation, high density of twin grain boundaries and stacking faults.
